title: Which prime can hold these roots?
hook: A modular root must cycle at the right length.

knows: Compare numbers; read a short array, string, tree or graph as drawn.
Binary masks, basic complex arithmetic for FFT, polynomial coefficients.
doesNotKnow: Perform an integer number-theoretic transform only when the modulus admits the required root order.

misconception: Any prime modulus supports any power-of-two transform length.
objective: Perform an integer number-theoretic transform only when the modulus admits the required root order.

claims.text: The root must have the required order in the modular field. Butterfly arithmetic then stays in integers modulo the prime. A root that collapses earlier powers does not separate the frequencies and cannot support the corresponding invertible transform.
